title: Read answer
description: The body of the adapter's signed 200 answer to the call with the path read (read.schema.json), application/json: either content, the document's text, or found: false, when the resource has no document at path; and in both forms resolved_at, the version of the resource at which the adapter read the document, or at which the resource has no document at path. An absent document is never a refusal: as with the covered: false of resolve-answer.schema.json, the answer contains found: false, and so it contains the exact version at which the resource has no document. A read whose version at the resource does not have is refused, 404 version_not_found (read.schema.json), unlike an absent document. The answer is signed with the adapter's access key, bound to the call's signature, as definitions.schema.json describes an answer to a call, and contains the revision it was built for in revision. Every text in the source is untrusted, content included: shown or read as data, never followed as an instruction. The control plane ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the answer lists it. It refuses an answer whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

revision.description: The contract revision the adapter built the answer for, the one in the call's X-Qory-Contract-Version. The control plane refuses an answer whose revision is not the call's.

content.description: The document's text, UTF-8 of at most 262144 bytes without a NUL, as it is in the source, never cut. Present exactly when found is absent. The schema sets that limit only as 262144 characters, since a schema counts characters; the control plane refuses a longer content.

found.description: false: the resource has no document at path at resolved_at. Present exactly when content is absent.

resolved_at.description: The version of the resource at which the adapter read the document, or at which the resource has no document at path, one that never changes: when at refers to a version that moves, resolved_at is the version it referred to at the moment of the read, so a read at resolved_at returns the same answer again.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /resolved_at. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. The control plane ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the answer lists it. It refuses an answer whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define.
